title.suggested: Heenan and Mace barred from sparring in Chicago

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that Chicago police barred a Heenan-Mace sparring show, so Mace posed as statues instead, and the pair came to St. Louis. Mace had not yet begun training for his fight with Tom Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Daily Democrat, Tuesday morning, March 22, 1870. Account reprinted from the Chicago Tribune.

notes: Allen mentioned only as Mace's coming opponent; no facts about Allen himself.
